theories.claim: SmokeProgress events from RunSmoke are translated into QAProgress events via emitQA, preserving nil-safety for req.Progress.
theories.basis: qa.go:299-301 wraps the QA progress callback so each SmokeProgress is re-emitted as a QAProgress with phase=QAPhaseRunning, event="smoke_"+phase, message preserved; emitQA at qa.go:1203-1207 short-circuits when progress is nil.
theories.confirmation_condition: A Suite=="smoke" RunQA invocation with nil Progress does not panic and emits no QAProgress events; a non-nil Progress receives one QAProgress per emitted SmokeProgress with the smoke_<phase> event prefix.
theories.refutation_condition: A nil req.Progress causes a panic during Suite=="smoke" smoke delegation, or smoke events are dropped without translation.
theories.inconclusive_condition: Smoke is short-circuited (dry-run / blocked / not-applicable) and emits no SmokeProgress, masking the wiring.
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Verify the Progress wrapper is closure-safe and that emitQA handles nil at qa.go:1203.

theories.confirmation_condition: qaResult.Smoke is non-nil and qaResult.Smoke.Verdict/Protocol/ScopeKind/Scope equal the direct smoke result; the harness runner.call count equals 2x the direct smoke invocation count (4 for one direct plus one QA-delegated run).

theories.inconclusive_condition: Direct RunSmoke itself fails or returns a non-pass verdict, masking parity assertions.

theories.claim: Smoke failure or blocked verdict maps the QAState.Phase to QAPhaseBlocked and the terminal result to QATerminalBlocked; a passing smoke maps to QAPhaseCompleted/QATerminalCompleted.
theories.basis: qa.go:302-306 sets phase/terminal defaults to Completed and overrides to Blocked when smokeErr != nil OR smoke.Status != SmokeCompleted OR verdict is SmokeFailVerdict or SmokeBlockedVerdict.
theories.confirmation_condition: A failing smoke (fail or blocked verdict, or non-completed status) yields QAState.Phase == QAPhaseBlocked and Run.TerminalResult == QATerminalBlocked; a passing smoke yields QAPhaseCompleted/QATerminalCompleted.
theories.refutation_condition: A failing smoke produces QAState.Phase == QAPhaseCompleted, or a passing smoke produces QAPhaseBlocked.
theories.inconclusive_condition: Smoke passes (pass or pass_with_open_issues) so the failing branch is not exercised.
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read the conditional at qa.go:304 and confirm it covers all four failing conditions enumerated; cross-reference SmokeVerdict constants in smoke_types.go.

theories.claim: Writer token validation and Resume/FocusShard rejection occur before any smoke work begins on the Suite=="smoke" branch, satisfying the "valid writer token" precondition comment in RunQA's docstring.
theories.basis: qa.go:296-298 calls req.WriterToken.Validate() before RunSmoke; qa.go:293-295 rejects Resume or FocusShard combinations before any work.
theories.confirmation_condition: An empty/invalid writer token (e.g., zero fencing generation) returns NewQAError(QAErrorConflict, ...) without invoking RunSmoke; a Resume or FocusShard smoke request returns NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, ...) without invoking RunSmoke.
theories.refutation_condition: An invalid writer token or Resume/FocusShard combination proceeds to RunSmoke before rejection.
theories.inconclusive_condition: The failure modes of Validate() are not all enumerated in source (Token.Validate may accept some malformed shapes).
